steps.title: Synthesize and subclone gene
steps.instruction: Obtain the codon‑optimized K. brevis EH gene (contig MGID2034061) synthesized by Genescript and initially cloned into pUC57; subclone the insert into the pET30a+ expression vector.

steps.title: Design and amplify insert with primers
steps.instruction: Design primers (Forward: CACAATCATATGCCGCTGACGGA; Reverse: AATAAGCTTTAATGATGATGATGATGATGCAGACGGCTCTGATTTTTAT) that add an NdeI site to the forward primer, a HindIII site and six histidine codons to the reverse primer, then PCR‑amplify the codon‑optimized EH insert.

steps.title: Ligate PCR product into pET30a+
steps.instruction: Ligate the PCR product into pET30a+ using T4 DNA ligase (Invitrogen) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Transform into BL21(DE3)
steps.instruction: Introduce the ligation mixture into E. coli BL21(DE3) cells by electroporation and recover according to the manufacturer’s guide (Invitrogen).

steps.title: Select colonies and verify plasmid
steps.instruction: Plate transformed cells, pick white colonies, grow them in LB broth containing kanamycin (50 Lg/ml), isolate plasmid DNA with the QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit (Qiagen), and send the plasmid to Eurofins Genomics for sequencing to confirm insert fidelity.

steps.title: Inoculate starter culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a fresh LB broth with kanamycin (50 Lg/ml) using the verified recombinant E. coli, and shake at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Scale‑up and induce expression
steps.instruction: Dilute 5 ml of the overnight culture into 500 ml fresh LB broth with kanamycin (50 Lg/ml), shake at 37 °C, 250 rpm for 2–3 h; when OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.6–0.8, add IPTG to a final concentration of 1 mM and continue shaking for an additional 4–6 h.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the induced culture at 5 000×g for 10 min, discard supernatant, and keep the cell pellet.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in B‑PER bacterial protein extraction reagent (Thermal Scientific) at 4 ml per gram of cells, add lysozyme (2 µl of 50 mg/ml) and DNase I (2 µl of 2 500 U/ml), incubate at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 15 000×g for 5 min to remove insoluble material; collect the supernatant for purification.

steps.title: Ni‑NTA affinity purification
steps.instruction: Load the cleared supernatant onto a 1 ml Ni‑NTA agarose column (Qiagen). Wash the column with buffer containing 20 mM phosphate, 0.5 M NaCl, 20 mM imidazole, 10 % glycerol, pH 7.9 until A₂₈₀ shows no further protein elution (typically ~10 ml wash). Elute the bound protein with 10 ml of buffer containing 20 mM phosphate, 0.5 M NaCl, 250 mM imidazole, 10 % glycerol, pH 7.9.

steps.title: Dialyze and store protein
steps.instruction: Dialyze the eluate using a membrane with a 12–14 kDa molecular‑weight cutoff against 50 mM sodium phosphate buffer, pH 7.0, at 0–4 °C overnight; flash‑freeze the dialyzed protein in liquid N₂ and store at –80 °C. Final protein concentration should be 0.2–0.3 mg/ml.
